LESSON: THE HIDDEN TREASURE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of JesusChrist
Topic 3.6: The Hidden Treasure
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Hidden Treasure, part of The Life of JesusChrist in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: what they treasure most in their lives, • brainstorm on the value of the Kingdom of God, ‘Why is it so valuable?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. define the meaning of the word, ‘treasure’,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. define the meaning of the word, ‘treasure’,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Hidden Treasure together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: the skill of knowing self is enhanced as learners, in small groups, share what they value in life.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of active listening and communication is enhanced as learners follow

simple instructions and as they share how they respond to the call of salvation in their lives.

Values:
Unity: learners display team spirit as they perform different tasks, in pairs and groups, and respect each other’s opinions.

Link to other Learning Areas:

• English: speaking skills are enhanced as learners brainstorm and discuss, in groups, what they value most in their lives.

• Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners compose and sing a song about the value of the Kingdom of God.
